dedupe_keys.name: amplifiers in multi band scenarios output power requirements control and performance characteristics

description: Rapp, Lutz and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. A generic optical-amplifier model determines output-power, gain and noise requirements as occupied bands expand from C+L to include S. Coverage includes maximum channel loading and the effect of designing for power-transient tolerance. The analysis distinguishes limited L-band output from possible C-band power increases. Related papers discuss transient response and energy efficiency without proving another independent implementation. The model is intended to be technology-independent; its numerical parameters and code access are not established by the native abstract. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-nc-nd-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements.
